findings.title: Missing vs deliberate-empty not distinguishable without the database
findings.detail: At close, a never-submitted team is recorded with audit action missing_submission_defaulted and a deliberately-empty draft with deadline_lock, but both become status=locked and no instructor endpoint surfaces the difference. The spec requires distinguishing them without direct database intervention; CR-012 added the audit action but not operator-facing visibility.

findings.title: Individual submitter (locked_by) not surfaced
findings.detail: DecisionSubmission.locked_by_id is populated (CR-004) but no instructor endpoint exposes who on the team submitted/locked; visibility is team-level (members list + locked_at).

findings.title: decision-status endpoint returns HTTP 500
findings.detail: /api/rounds/<id>/decision-status/ is a stale legacy view (references Program/SimulationState, Round.round_id) and 500s. The instructor UI does not call it (it uses /instructor/dashboard/), so it is orphaned dead code rather than a live-path break.
